name: Ojai Oil Company
summary: Ojai Oil Company's primary business involves the operation and upkeep of self-storage facilities, chiefly located in Southern California and Southern Nevada. Expanding its real estate portfolio, the company also manages commercial and residential buildings. Beyond property management, Ojai Oil actively invests in, extracts, markets, and oversees oil and gas assets. Furthermore, the company diversifies its holdings through investments in securities and the ownership and operation of communication towers, offering space for antenna and microwave equipment. Founded in 1900, Ojai Oil Company is based in Camarillo, California.
